title: ProvisionalEvent
description: Payload of a provisional-branch event in the session log (PB, X3 revised), validated before it is appended. `kind` equals the event's `type`; the writer checks that relation. A run that ends with a pending owner decision of class technology or scope forks one provisional commit per decision from the floor's own candidate tree. Fork and discard are Ring 0 and pure functions of logged facts: the commit ID is recomputed on replay. The log holds no recommendation (Q48). PB-1 writes `provisional.opened` or `provisional.refused`; the other two are reserved for the work that builds on a provisional branch (PB-2) and for the owner's answer (PB-3).

opened.title: ProvisionalOpened
opened.description: A provisional commit was made for the owner decision `decisionId`, logged after that `decision.opened` and before `floor.checked`, in the floor's transaction. `ref` is `refs/helmwright/provisional/<decisionId>` in the host repository's common git dir; it is created only after the transaction commits, is never under `refs/heads` and is never pushed. `commit` is the deterministic commit of `tree` (the floor's `candidateTree`) on `baseCommit`.

class.description: The decision's class: architecture is never provisional.

refused.title: ProvisionalRefused
refused.description: The fork for the owner decision `decisionId` was refused, logged in place of `provisional.opened`: `cap` means the repository already has the most open provisional branches. The floor is logged as usual; only the run fails.

attached.title: ProvisionalAttached
attached.description: Reserved (PB-2): a run's work was built on the provisional commit `commit` of the pending decision `decisionId`. Not written by PB-1.

resolved.title: ProvisionalResolved
resolved.description: Reserved (PB-3): the owner answered `decisionId`, so its provisional branch was confirmed or discarded. Not written by PB-1.

resolvedBy.description: Who resolved it: the ID of the event or the owner answer that did, as shown text.

oid.description: A full lowercase hex git object ID (SHA-1 or SHA-256).
